items.title: Annie Ross — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Tess Trainer in her response; she only discusses Wardell's wife.

ctx.x: She was wonderful, and Tony, Tony Richardson.
In Short Cuts you actually got to play a vocalist, called Tess Trainer. Can you talk about that one? Was that a more suited role for you?

I certainly knew what it was about. I got Wardell’s wife a little part. I told her to come on the set. I introduced her to Bob, and he gave her lines, which entitled her to become a member of whatever it is.
